about: Things to do someday, ticked off when they happen.

table.name: Bucket List
table.description: Things to do before you die, ticked off as they happen.
conventions: Item is the thing itself in a few words, in their words: 'See the northern lights', 'Hike the Camino', not 'Bucket list item about travel'.
One recording can add several items: 'bucket list: skydiving, learn to surf, see Petra' is three creates.

When they say they did one ('I finally saw the northern lights, check it off'), update that existing item with Done = true and Done On = the recording's date. Never add a second copy of something already on the list.
Anything extra they say about an item (why, with whom, when) goes in Notes.

fields.name: Item
